newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-WOMAN GAMBLER STAKES FORTUNE ON TEST DRAW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WOMAN GAMBLER STAKES FORTUNE ON TEST DRAW.

text.p: Britain's highest-spending sporting gambler has staked the world's largest cricketing bet on the second test between England and Australia ending in a draw, William Hill bookmakers said on Thursday.
The unnamed woman has staked 159,000 pounds ($260,000), adding 100,000 pounds to her original bet as rain delayed the start of the test at Lord's in London on Thursday.
The first 50,000 was laid at odds of 4-6 and the 100,000 pounds at 2-5. If she wins, she will pocket 235,933 pounds for a profit of 62,623 pounds when tax is taken into account.

"This is the most astonishing gamble we've ever seen," said William Hill spokesman Graham Sharpe. "It is one of the largest bets we have ever taken on anything at all." Rain is expected to continue for much of the day in London.
The woman already holds world records for the biggest political and rugby union bets ever laid, William Hill said.

She staked 151,000 pounds on Labour winning the May 1 British election -- winning 25,000 pounds -- and 78,000 pounds on England beating Wales in this year's Five Nations match. She made a profit of 26,000 pounds on that bet. ($ = 0.609 British Pounds)
